title: Raku Firing – October 10
summary: Fire raku pots you've made in Old School Clay workshops, or help crew the firing on October 10.
how_to_join: Sign up on the event page.
source_quote:
Raku Firing – October 10
October 10 @ 4:00 pm - 7:00 pm
Raku Firing – October 10
This is for folks to sign up to fire any raku pots, or fish, they have made in my workshops - or help.
evidence_sentence: The events page lists raku firings where potters sign up to fire pots made in workshops or volunteer as crew.
